messages:
Marta (Content): Quick heads-up — draft SunVault customer case study is ready for sign-off. Need legal + CS review on the quote and a final design asset. Proposed publish: Apr 16 09:00 PT. Doc: https://drive.google.com/sunvault-case-draft

Ethan (Comms): Nice. Do we have permission to publish the usage numbers in the draft? We redacted MAUs earlier.

Sabrina (CS): I spoke with Alex at SunVault this morning — they confirmed the high-level numbers are OK but asked we swap one metric wording. They prefer '95th percentile latency' not 'p99' in the body. Suggested wording pasted below.

Sabrina (CS): ```
"With Redwood Dedicated, SunVault lowered p95 inference latency by ~30% and cut inference spend by 42%."
```

Joey (Legal): On this. Two small redlines from legal: (1) add a short release clause: "published with customer consent" next to the quote; (2) soften the indemnity-sounding phrasing in the technical claims section. I'll paste redline suggestions in the doc.

Marta (Content): Thanks — adding your redlines now. @Riley (Design) can you update the hero quote graphic to the final wording once I drop it? Also — does marketing have the signed release on file?

Riley (Design): Yep, can update hero. Need final one-line quote text from content team. ETA EOD for new hero image.

Joey (Legal): Legal sign-off is conditional on a signed release PDF. Sabrina — can you confirm SunVault has signed? If not, we need them to sign before publishing.

Sabrina (CS): They signed it yesterday and emailed the PDF to me. Uploading to drive now: https://drive.google.com/sunvault-release.pdf :white_check_mark:

Marta (Content): Awesome. Final candidate quote below — please call out any last edits: "SunVault reduced inference costs by 42% while lowering 95th percentile latency by 30% using Redwood Dedicated."

Ethan (Comms): Small nit on copy: for public/press copy we should use '95th percentile latency' spelled out (good for non-technical readers). For the technical deep-dive we can use 'p95'. Recommend marketing uses the spelled-out version in headline and social.

Joey (Legal): Reviewed final quote and release. Legal approves publication wording and confirms signed release on file. Approved for press. :tada:

Marta (Content): Great — scheduling publish for Apr 16 09:00 PT. I'll open the PR on the marketing site and attach final assets. @Ethan can you prepare social/snippets and the webinar CTA?

Ethan (Comms): On it — I'll draft social + newsletter copy and drop it into the PR. Will also prepare a short webinar CTA linking to the signup.

Marta (Content): Thanks team. Final checklist: design hero (Riley), social copy (Ethan), release PDF attached (Sabrina), legal sign-off (Joey). I'll tag this as "publish-ready" when PR is up.

Riley (Design): Got it — will upload updated hero by EOD and attach PNG/SVG to the PR.

Sabrina (CS): I'll post the internal handoff to AMs after publish so SunVault's account team can field inbound leads.

Ethan (Comms): I'll also prepare two social variants (technical + product) and one short executive quote for LinkedIn.

Joey (Legal): All clear on my end. Ping if wording changes.

Marta (Content): Thanks everyone — closing loop here. :rocket:
